reasons: Claimed status is 'compliant' and the cited text supports it: § 12.3 expressly states that nothing restricts Customer from 'hiring any person who responds to general recruitment' and that Customer 'has made no ... no-hire commitment,' which matches the preferred position (no non-solicit on Customer).
No redline and no counterparty comment were proposed, which is the correct output for a compliant finding; the rendered paragraph is unchanged from the original.

The failed deterministic checks (duration ≤ 12 months; general-solicitation carve-out) are keyed to the existence of a non-solicit covenant and have nothing to measure where no such covenant binds Customer; they do not undercut compliance here.
Rationale is accurate and rule-complete: it addresses duration, scope, no-hire and carve-out elements of the rule, and correctly reserves the fallback for any future Vendor-proposed covenant.
